retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-inspired theatrical layout featuring a minimalist line-art character balanced on a globe, paired with high-contrast sans-serif and expressive hand-lettered titles.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, off-white composition dominated by a vertical line-art figure of a performer in oversized trousers balancing on a wireframe globe, flanked by a dense, left-aligned typographic stack in red and black.
coreVisualRelationships: The character's verticality anchors the right third of the frame.
The large red title acts as a horizontal bridge between the text block and the illustration.
The wireframe globe provides a geometric base for the organic figure.
Negative space in the center-right creates a sense of precarious balance.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black, white, and red palette
Minimalist line-art character with star-shaped eyes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A tall, slender character occupies the right 40% of the canvas, standing atop a globe at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The wireframe globe at the bottom right serves as the structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left credits, moves down to the bold red title, then follows the character's gaze and posture down to the globe.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space between the central text and the character's torso to emphasize the 'floating' feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/cream background providing a vintage paper texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for primary text and character outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant tomato red for the main title to draw immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Flat, high-contrast values with no gradients or shading.

letterConstructionRules: Primary titles use heavy, condensed sans-serif with slight irregularities.
Main show title uses bouncy, hand-drawn letterforms with varying baselines.
Secondary credits use clean, wide-set sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the red title is slightly squashed and tilted.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, irregular display face paired with a clean, functional Swiss-style sans-serif for credits.

avoid: Italics (except for 'in association with' style text)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and feel of the performer names.
Captures the bouncy, irregular energy of the red title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an off-white paper texture with a minimalist black line-art illustration of a mime-like character in baggy pants balancing on a wireframe globe on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a dense block of left-aligned text on the left side. Use a heavy red hand-drawn font for the main title and a condensed black sans-serif for the credits and names.

verificationChecks: Is the character on the right side?
Is the main title red and the rest black?
Is the background a textured off-white?

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality in the red title
avoid: Perfectly straight baselines in the title

postGenerationChecks: Verify the globe is a simple wireframe sphere.
Check that the character's eyes are simple star/cross shapes.
Confirm the red title is the largest element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [minimalist line-art character] + [asymmetric left-aligned typography] + [high-contrast red/black/cream palette] to evoke [1960s theatrical design].
